text:
Alex G: Morning team — quick async standup. Doing kernel + batching + KV work today. Landed the microbatch slot allocator patch last night; noticed a weird tail on the 2k-seq perf run. If you're blocked or need reviews, drop notes here.

Maria S: Did: ran prefix eviction tuning on canary GPUs, rolled prefetch3 to 10% canary. Observed ~6% p99 down on 512 seq but a small p50 regress on 128 (weird). Blocker: unclear threshold tradeoffs between slot_count and batch_timeout. Today: iterate on slot backoff heuristic and open PR. @Samir K can you eyeball my PR? https://redwood.local/pr/3421

Samir K: ACK, will review. Did: patched batching backpressure to early-exit on empty-kv reads, ran quick microburst harness. Saw noisy results in microburst tests. Blocker: CI flaky on kernel-smoke (OOM) intermittently. Plan: run isolated microburst harness with --burst=1000 to repro. Also think a feature-flag to disable prefetch for tiny inputs would help.

Jordan L: FYI I reproduced a memory bump: small inputs + long KV chains trigger a leak in prefetch iterator. Pushed a minimal reproducer to my fork and filed #INF-682. Not blocking canary but should fix before full rollout.

CI-bot: canary-deploy: build/canary-3421 failed smoke-test: kernel-smoke — exit code 137. Logs: https://ci.redwood.local/builds/3421/log

Maria S: thanks @Jordan. Quick bench snippet from my run:
```bash
# microburst harness
./tools/microburst --model t5-small --seq 512 --batch 16 --iters 200 --kv-warm 4
# results
p50: 23ms
p95: 48ms
p99: 89ms
tok/s: 12,400
```
Memory trend: +200MB over first 50 iters when prefetch enabled.

Alex G: Re: p50 regress on 128 — sounds like batch coalescing for small seq is hurting. Quick experiment: lower batch_timeout from 12ms -> 6ms and run a short smoke.

Samir K: running that now. If repro, I'll add an adaptive timeout: reduce when seq < 256. Also will run the --burst=1000 harness and post logs.

Jordan L: I'll dig into the iterator finalizer in the reproducer; suspect a stale ref held by the prefetch state machine. Filing a tiny PR to guard: assign me + Maria.

Maria S: small ask — can someone rerun the canary with kv-ttl=0 and prefetch=false flags to get a baseline? If yes, drop :thumbsup:.

Alex G: I'll kick a quick canary with those flags and report back in ~20m. @Samir K remind me to merge your backpressure fix after green.

CI-bot: scheduled: canary-run/1769998895 with flags: --kv-ttl=0 --prefetch=false

Samir K: noted. Also added a flaky-ignore for kernel-smoke in nightly bench until we root-cause.

Jordan L: PR up to guard iterator finalizer, assigning Maria for review: https://redwood.local/pr/3429

Maria S: reviewing now.

Alex G: Thanks all. If PRs + canary clear, aim to promote prefetch3 to 25% after lunch. Quick sync later if needed.
